name: nanyx
description: Nanyx language support: syntax highlighting, diagnostics and running files

semanticTokenTypes.description: A name that names nothing in scope: an unknown value, function, member, type, context or module

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A nominal type: one declared protected or private, whose name matters, as opposed to an alias of its shape
A private type, whose shape is hidden outside the module that declares it
A cell: a local made with mut, or a parameter that takes one

commands.title: Add import to the active file

nanyx.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `nanyx` executable (the compiler, which is also the language server). Leave empty to use the `nanyx` on PATH, or to download a release into the extension's storage.

nanyx.developmentMode.markdownDescription: For working on the compiler: runs the language server from a copy of the `#nanyx.path#` build, so the build is never locked and `dotnet build` can overwrite it, and restarts the server with a fresh copy whenever the build changes. The Nanyx output channel then also shows how long each module took to check in each compile. Needs `#nanyx.path#` to be set.

nanyx.compilerVersion.markdownDescription: Pins the compiler release to download and use when no `nanyx` is found, e.g. `0.5.2`. Leave empty to use the newest compiler release (checked for at most once a day).

nanyx.downloadUrl.markdownDescription: Where to download the compiler from. `${version}`, `${rid}` (e.g. `win-x64`) and `${ext}` (`zip` or `tar.gz`) are substituted. Leave empty for the GitHub releases of nanyx-lang/nanyx. With a custom URL the newest release cannot be looked up, so `nanyx.compilerVersion` (or the extension's minimum version) is downloaded.

nanyx.asciiTypes.markdownDescription: Write the types that hovers, lenses, inlay hints and completions show in ASCII only: inferred type variables are `a`, `b`, `c`, ... rather than `α`, `β`, `γ`, …, and the rest of an open record is `...` rather than `…`.

nanyx.greekTypeVariables.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#nanyx.asciiTypes#` instead. Turning this off still turns ASCII types on.
nanyx.greekTypeVariables.markdownDescription: Name inferred type variables `α`, `β`, `γ`, … in hovers.

enumDescriptions: As an inlay hint after each top-level definition's name, like the hints for locals and parameters.
In a lens above each top-level definition.
nanyx.topLevelTypeHints.markdownDescription: Where to show the inferred type of a top-level definition that does not write its type. `off` and `inlayHint` pass `--top-level-type-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.

nanyx.inlayHints.localDefinitions.markdownDescription: Show an inlay hint with the inferred type of each local definition (a `def` in a block) that does not write its type. Turning it off passes `--no-local-type-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.

nanyx.inlayHints.parameters.markdownDescription: Show an inlay hint with the inferred type of each lambda parameter that does not write its type. Turning it off passes `--no-parameter-type-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.

nanyx.inlayHints.patternVariables.markdownDescription: Show an inlay hint with the inferred type of each variable a pattern binds. Turning it off passes `--no-pattern-variable-type-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.

nanyx.formattingHints.markdownDescription: Mark the lines that `nanyx format` would change, with a quick fix that formats them. Turning it off passes `--no-format-hints` to `nanyx lsp`, which needs a compiler that has it.

enumDescriptions: Highlight the provider and its calls, and draw no lines.
Also draw a line down the left margin from the provider to its last call, with a short tick at each.
Also draw a line down the left margin, and from it a line across to the provider and to each call.
nanyx.infoView.contextLines.markdownDescription: How the editor shows the flow of contexts that the info view highlights, with the cursor on a `use`, a context in a signature, or a call. The lines are drawn in the `nanyx.contextLine` colour, which `workbench.colorCustomizations` can change.

enumDescriptions: In VS Code's built-in Simple Browser, in a tab beside the editor. If Simple Browser is disabled, in the system browser.
nanyx.infoView.openDocsIn.markdownDescription: Where the info view opens a link to the docs site, nanyx.dev, such as a message's error code, which links to its entry in the errors reference. Other links open as VS Code opens links.

nanyx.live.timeLimit.markdownDescription: How many seconds a live run may take before it is stopped, so that a program that never ends doesn't keep a process busy. See **Live mode** in the Nanyx sidebar.

enumDescriptions: What each `dbg` writes, as `▸ 84` at the end of its line.
Every value the program's code binds or gives, each `def` that isn't a function and each statement that gives more than `()`, as `= 84` at the end of its line, and what each `dbg` writes.
nanyx.live.show.markdownDescription: What a live run shows in the editor. **Live mode** in the Nanyx sidebar and **Nanyx: Toggle showing every value** switch it.

colors.description: The lines the info view draws in the editor between a provider of contexts and the calls it serves.

program.description: The script, or a package's directory, to debug. Without it, the active file.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's first statement.

cwd.description: The directory the program runs in. Without it, the script's directory, or the package's.

configurationSnippets.description: Debug a package's @entry with nanyx run --debug.
